### Added

- *(credprovider)* Audit every actor-JWT authentication as the bound person in [#1594](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1594) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(oauth)* Render the browser sign-in pages with pagekit in [#1593](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1593) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(mcpserver)* Key servers by namespace and name; no identity outside muster's namespace in [#1508](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1508) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(credprovider)* The git user per provider instance, oauth2 for GitLab in [#1586](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1586) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(oauth)* Disconnecting a subject-scoped grant revokes it at the provider in [#1599](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1599) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(oauth)* A tenant server's sign-in stays in its namespace in [#1598](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1598) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(aggregator)* List MCP servers as the caller in [#1601](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1601) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(aggregator)* Relay MCP resource subscriptions per user (subscriptions/listen) in [#1600](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1600) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(agent)* Show the sign-in's outcome on the CLI callback page in [#1596](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1596) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
